title: ACTIONS (CONT.)
frontText:
ACTIONS (CONT.)
RECON
Discard cards at an eligible location to explore the world.
The location must contain a supply center.
MAKE SUPPLIES
Take 1 Supply cube from the stockpile and put it onto your Character card.
DELIVER SUPPLIES
Put any number of Supply cubes from your Character card into your current location.
FREE ACTIONS
Do any number of free actions during the "Do Actions" step of your turn.
PICK UP SUPPLIES
Take any number of Supply cubes from your location and put them onto your Character card.
TRANSFER SUPPLIES
Give Supply cubes to another player in your location or take Supply cubes from that player (with permission).

mechanics.timing: The continued action list, plus free actions during the "Do Actions" step.
mechanics.effect: white pawn. Actions continued and free actions.
